_meta.policy: Zero fabrication. Two source portals are used: (1) Florida Product Approval portal (floridabuilding.org) publishes statewide FL# approvals — FL#, Type, Category, Manufacturer, Status. (2) Miami-Dade Product Control (miamidade.gov/building) publishes HVHZ-only NOAs — NOA#, Category, Material, Description, Impact rating, design pressure (MDP+/-), and expiration date. The two systems are SEPARATE — a single physical product may have an FL approval, a Miami-Dade NOA, both, or neither. Each is tracked in its own list per manufacturer below. 'pending verification' means the cell has not been hand-confirmed yet.

tgp.portal_note: Technical Glass Products is not listed in the Florida Product Approval portal under that name. TGP fire-rated glazing is regulated by IBC/NFPA test methods (UL 9, UL 10B, UL 263, NFPA 252, NFPA 257) rather than the Florida wind-load product-approval system. ACG verifies TGP listings against UL Online Certifications Directory and Intertek Directory of Listed Products for each project.
